report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show successful downstream calls (inventory, payment, order, redis, postgres) with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. Healthy telemetry contradicts any fault hypothesis, and no baseline or error evidence establishes a bounded root cause. Handing off for operator review rather than asserting a cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Evidence of errors or non-200 responses on checkout path (none observed)
Dependency-level latency breakdown to attribute any slowness to a specific downstream
Historical latency trend to distinguish normal variance from regression
